Overview

The NOT Gate is a logic gate used in various applications within the game.

Description

The NOT Gate activates an output of 0.0 when the input is greater than 0.0; otherwise, it will output 10.0.

This functionality is crucial for basic tasks in different setups.

Requirements

To use the NOT Gate, you must connect 2 wires: one for the input and one for the output. Connect the side with the triangle to the input and the side with the circle to the output. This setup ensures that the NOT Gate functions correctly and inverts the signal as intended.
